## Cross-Cutting Requirements

### Data provenance

All new claims must have evidence edges in `registry/claims_evidence_edges.toml` (auto-generated by `build_registry_semantic_atoms.py` from backtick-quoted paths in claim fields). Pioneer Doppler residual time series must be acquired from PDS-PPI/SPICE before the fractal metric sweep.

### Rust-first

All new analysis must be implemented in Rust crates or binaries (`gororoba_cli_physics`, `gororoba_cli_algebra`). Python scripts are migration debt only.

### Falsifiability

Each new claim must specify a concrete falsification criterion. For the D_f(r) conjecture: if the magnitude discrepancy persists at all trajectory intervals, the fractal metric hypothesis is refuted. For gap universality: if any dim ≥ 64 shows ||[e_i,e_k,e_{i⊕half}]||² ≠ 4, the universality conjecture is refuted.
